biotools.summary: BounTI is an open-access tool for automatic segmentation of calcified tissues, specifically focusing on craniofacial bones. It utilizes iterative thresholding to preserve boundaries between segments and is available as an Avizo/Amira add-on, a stand-alone Windows executable, and a Python library.
